_help: BAU stations: the quick-zoom list under BAU ▾ on the map. Each one also gets platform outlines and numbers when zoomed in (tools/build_platforms.py). To add one, add the station's name exactly as it appears on the map (for example "Toowong station" or "Chermside bus station"), commit, and the next refresh (or Actions -> Refresh Translink data -> Run workflow) does the rest. Order here is the order in the menu.
